scares.description: A masked man breaks the window of Corey’s car as he is about to drive off.
A severed head is slammed into a window. [Video]
There is a loud gun shot.
Johnny is hit over the head as he tries to escape.
A close up shot of a man’s face as he is shot in the eye may startle some viewers.
A woman looks up while crawling through a wheat field and sees a scarecrow.
Jami sees a bloodied face lying beside her in bed.
The killer’s masked face suddenly appears on the screen, accompanied by a sound effect. [Video]
